# SYNTHETIC HOSTILE btmon 5.72 capture for the SquachWatch tests. The LAYOUT is copied from the
# real capture test/fixtures/btmon_live_2026-09-22.txt; the device VALUES are NOT from real devices.
# btmon prints advertised names raw, so a name holding newlines can forge btmon-shaped lines: in
# the AA:00:00:00:00:66 and :65 reports every line after "Name (complete): Mallory..." up to the
# real RSSI/next event is the advertised NAME, not btmon output. :67 carries non-hex / odd-length
# Data, :70 a same-indent Appearance line after a 16-bit UUID list, :72 a name that contains
# "LE Advertising Report", :77 an extended report whose only RSSI is 127 ("not available").
# F9:C1:A3:83:F0:48 (separated Find My, Data from the live capture) and :71 are legitimate.

        Status: Success (0x00)
